description: Screen a counterparty an agent is about to pay. Runs entirely offline: address sanity, dynamic-payTo comparison, transport check, and your spending policy. Returns allow / review / block with reasons. Advisory: the caller decides. Set FRISK_API_KEY to add hosted reputation signals.

allowedAssets.description: Assets the agent is permitted to pay in.

amount.description: Amount the agent is about to pay.

counterparty.description: The address the agent intends to pay, e.g. an 0x EVM address.

endpoint.description: URL that quoted the payment. Used to check transport safety.

maxPerCall.description: Spending ceiling for a single call.

observedPayTo.description: The payTo address the endpoint actually returned for this request. If it differs from the counterparty, that is the dynamic-payTo swap.

strictness.description: 0 is permissive, 1 is paranoid. Defaults to 0.3.

name: screen_payment
title: Screen a payment before paying
